title: Weight and dimensions restrictions
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains up-to-date information on weight and dimensions restrictions on state roads that are set to ensure road safety, prevent damages to roads, bridges. The dataset is available in GeoJson format and includes information on temporary, permanent, virtual weight and dimensional restrictions.

title: Unprotected accident area
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes up-to-date information received from the Traffic Information Center of SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on not yet demarcated accident locations. As the dataset contains information on unexpected and dangerous situations on the state roads, the events included in it are considered as dangerous for safe traffic.

title: Temporary slippery road (Road maintenance reports)
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes reports from Road Maintainers on current events and conditions on state roads that cause temporarily slippery roads. Such events include, for example, black ice, icing, slippery road sections, oil spills on the road surface, etc. As slippery road conditions significantly impair driving safety, the events included in the dataset are considered dangerous to traffic.

title: Border crossing waiting time
field_dataset_description:
As of 15 October 2025, the crossing time of the EU external land border when exiting the Republic of Latvia is determined individually only through the Electronic Queue Reservation System (ERRS).
As a result, waiting in a physical vehicle queue is no longer reflected, as it has been fully replaced by a time slot reservation, which designates the period during which a vehicle must arrive at the border control point.
The e-service and additional information are available at www.lvborder.lv

title: Lane closures
field_dataset_description: The data set includes VSIA "Latvijas Valsts ceļi" Traffic Information Centre's current data on events or circumstances on state roads that have resulted in lane closures, e.g. due to traffic accidents, as well as data on other restrictions in force, e.g. road works.

title: Riga City Municipal Police Traffic enforcement cameras
field_dataset_description: Riga City Municipal Police Traffic enforcement cameras that monitor compliance with traffic regulations in Riga.

title: Temporary slippery road (Weather monitoring station data)
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes interpreted real-time measurement data received from road weather station equipment owned by VSIA “Latvijas Valsts ceļi”, as well as photographic records whose interpretations indicate the conditions that cause a temporarily slippery road surface. Such events include, for example, black ice, icing, slippery road sections, etc. As slippery road conditions significantly impair driving safety, the events included in the dataset are considered dangerous to traffic.

title: Exceptional weather conditions (Weather station data)
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes interpreted real-time measurement data received from road weather stations owned by SLLC “Latvian State Roads”, as well as photo recordings whose interpretations indicate exceptional weather conditions or unforeseen disasters that may significantly affect driving conditions, such as storm, heavy rainfall, heavy snowfall, hail etc. As exceptional weather conditions significantly impair driving safety, the events included in the dataset are considered dangerous to traffic.

title: Variable message sign locations (E77/A2)
field_dataset_description: The data set contains information about the locations of variable message signs on the main national road Riga-Sigulda-Veclaicene (A2/E77) in the section from km 14.7 to km 191.5. km.

title: Reduced visibility (Road maintenance reports)
field_dataset_description: The data set includes actual data received from the Road maintainers about events that have occurred as a result of poor environment conditions and significantly reduce visibility on the road, for instance, blowing snow, dense fog, patchy fog, smoke hazard, serious fire, etc. As reduced visibility conditions significantly impair driving safety, the events included in the dataset are considered dangerous to traffic.

title: Traffic Volume and Speed on State Roads (Hourly)
field_dataset_description: This dataset contains aggregated traffic data collected by traffic counting devices operated by SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on the state road network. The data includes traffic flow intensity, a breakdown between light and heavy vehicles, and average speed. Data is aggregated on an hourly basis and available for the last eight hours. All timestamps are provided in UTC.

title: Reduced visibility (Traffic information centre data)
field_dataset_description: The data set includes actual data received from the Traffic Information Center of SLLC “Latvian State Roads” about events that have occurred as a result of poor environment conditions and significantly reduce visibility on the road, for instance, blowing snow, dense fog, patchy fog, smoke hazard, serious fire, etc. As reduced visibility conditions significantly impair driving safety, the events included in the dataset are considered dangerous to traffic

title: Exceptional weather conditions (Road maintenance reports)
field_dataset_description:
Winter season (Oct.16–Apr.15): Snow lasts for more than 4h within a 24hour period and the snow layer exceeds 12cm in thickness, freezing rain or rain occurs multiple times creating ice on the road, wind exceeds 20m/s, snow drifts on roads, rain causes road flooding or reduces the road's load-bearing capacity.
Summer season (Apr.16–Oct.15): Wind exceeds 20m/s, ice forms on the road or snow falls, rain causes road flooding or reduces the road's loadbearing capacity. (Regulation No.26 07.01.2021)

title: Road transport mileage
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains information on the total mileage of road vehicles for the reference year (2025) on state roads and municipal roads outside urban areas (by road category), in accordance with Cabinet of Ministers Regulation No 209 of 29 March 2005 "Procedure for annual mileage accounting of road vehicles".

title: Location of warning road signs
field_dataset_description: The dataset with initial data, which is supplemented, includes current data from SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on road signs as point objects and information on their attributes in the national road network. The data set includes warning signs with road sign numbers from 101 to 143.

title: Location of speed limit road signs
field_dataset_description: The dataset with initial data, which is supplemented, includes current data from SLLC “Latvian State Roads”  on road signs as point objects and their attribute information on the speed value indicated by each specific sign on the state road network. The dataset includes speed limit signs with road sign numbers 323, 324, 423, 424, 525, 526, 531, 532, 552, 553, 555, 556, 725.

title: Alternative fuel refuelling stations
field_dataset_description: The dataset contain information provided by the operators of natural gas refueling or hydrogen refueling point regarding the publicly available infrastructure for the filling (recharging) of alternative motor vehicle fuels. Information provider – operator (owner or legal possessor) of publicly available facilities for filling/charging alternative fuels (electricity, LPG, CNG, LNG, hydrogen), which ensures accessibility of services to users.

title: Reduced visibility (Weather stations data)
field_dataset_description: The data set includes interpreted real time measurement data that are received from SLLC “Latvian State Roads” owned road weather stations, and the interpretations of which indicate significantly reduced visibility, for example, blowing snow, dense fog, patchy fog, smoke hazard, etc. As reduced visibility conditions significantly impair driving safety, the events included in the dataset are considered dangerous to traffic.

title: Wrong-way driver
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes up-to-date information or real-time data about driver(s) driving in the wrong or opposite direction on the roadway, endangering other road users. Since such events significantly impair driving safety, the events included in the dataset are considered dangerous to traffic.

title: Animals, people, obstacles, debris on the road
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes up-to-date information from the Latvian State Roads Traffic Information Centre about unexpected obstacles on the roadway – such as people, animals, fallen cargo, etc. Since these obstacles may necessitate emergency maneuvers, the events included in the dataset are considered as dangerous for safe traffic.

title: Weather conditions affecting road surface and visibility (Traffic information centre data)
field_dataset_description: The data set includes current data received by the Traffic Information Center of SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on weather conditions that may affect road surface and visibility, thereby worsen driving conditions, such as snowstorms, rain showers, etc.

title: Weather conditions affecting road surface and visibility (Weather monitoring station data)
field_dataset_description: The data set includes interpreted real time measurement data that are received from SLLC “Latvian State Roads” owned road weather stations, as well as photo fixations, the interpretations of which indicate weather conditions that may affect road surface and visibility, thereby worsen driving conditions, such as snowstorms, rain showers, etc.

title: State road network links and their physical attributes
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes the latest data from SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on sections of the state road network and their physical attributes, such as the location of the carriageways of national roads and their geometric lengths.

title: State road classification
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes latest data on the classification of state roads managed by SLLC “Latvian State Roads” according to their significance. According to the regulatory framework, state roads are classified into main (A), regional (P) and local (V) state roads.

title: Temporary slippery road (Traffic information centre data)
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes up-to-date data received by the Traffic Information Centre of the SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on events and conditions on state roads that cause temporarily slippery roads. Such events include, for example, black ice, icing, slippery road sections, oil spills on the road surface, etc. As slippery road conditions significantly impair driving safety, the events included in the dataset are considered dangerous to traffic.

title: Road closures
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains up-to-date information on state roads or sections of state roads that are closed to traffic.

title: Location of parking places and service areas
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains information on car parking and rest areas along state roads. All car parking areas are publicly accessible for all types of vehicles. However, in car parking areas with a small surface area, access for freight vehicles may be limited.

title: Location of technical traffic control devices in Jurmala State City
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains information on the location of technical traffic control devices in Jurmala State City in accordance with Cabinet Regulation No. 224 of 12 April 2022. The dataset includes the device type, location coordinates, status, address, location description, notes, object identifier and data update date.

title: Accidents and incidents
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains up-to-date information on unexpected situations and events on national roads that may cause damage to vehicles, injuries or loss of life, or disrupt traffic flow, such as accidents, spilled cargo, animals on the road, fallen trees, etc.

title: Variable message signs real-time data (E77/A2)
field_dataset_description: The data set contains real-time information from variable message signs on the main national road Riga-Sigulda-Veclaicene (A2/E77) in the section from km 14.7 to km 191.5. km. The variable message signs are designed according to the European standard EN 12966 and display information about the maximum driving speed, traffic warnings such as slippery roads, strong winds, as well as warnings about roadworks, road temperatures, etc.

title: Short term road works
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains information on short-term road works (emergency works, maintenance works, etc.) that are carried out on or at the side of the road and are marked only with minimal signage and are therefore considered dangerous to traffic safety.

title: Weather station locations
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes data on road weather stations owned by SLLC "Latvian State Roads” and their locations. To link the weather stations included in this publication with their real-time measurement data, use the measurementSite ID specified in this publication, which corresponds to the ID specified in the measurementSiteReference data field of the publication “Real-time measurements of weather stations”.

title: Poor road conditions (Traffic information centre data)
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes current data received from the Traffic Information Center of SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on conditions or events that affect the road surface and worsen driving conditions, such as snow, sand on the road, road surface in poor conditions etc.

title: Real time measurements of weather stations
field_dataset_description: The data set contains real-time measurement data from the sensors of road weather stations owned by SLLC "Latvian State Roads" for the last 30 minutes using UTC time zone. To link the data included in this measurement publication to specific weather stations, use the ID in the measurementSiteReference field of this publication, which corresponds to the measurementSite ID in the publication "Weather Station Locations".

title: Micromobility infrastructure for cycling on the state road network.
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes information on cycling paths in the state road network managed by SLLC "Latvian State Roads".

title: Micromobility infrastructure for pedestrians on the state road network
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes information on pedestrian paths in the state road network managed by SLLC "Latvian State Roads.

title: Road works
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains up-to-date information on road construction and road works taking place on the state road network, their types and locations.

title: Poor road conditions (Weather monitoring station data)
field_dataset_description: The data set includes interpreted real-time measurement data received from road weather station equipment owned by SLLC “Latvian State Roads”, as well as photographs, the interpretation of which indicates conditions that affect the condition of the road surface and worsen driving conditions, such as snow, ice, water on the surface etc.

title: Traffic Volume and Speed on State Roads (Minute-Level)
field_dataset_description: This dataset provides near real-time traffic data collected by traffic counting devices operated by SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on the state road network. The data includes traffic flow intensity, a breakdown between light and heavy vehicles, and average speed. Data is aggregated on a per-minute basis and is available for the last 30 minutes. All timestamps are provided in UTC.

title: State road network
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains current data from SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on the state roads or road sections under its administration, in accordance with Cabinet Regulation No. 1104 of 29 September 2009. The data service also provides historical records, while the NPP map displays only current data. The “todate” attribute indicates the date until which the object formed part of the state road network and is populated following a change in ownership, road alignment, route, classification or index.

title: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Status and Price information from Eco-Movement
field_dataset_description: This dataset provides status information and prices of electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure from Eco-Movement for several operators.

title: Faulty Equipment on State Roads
field_dataset_description: This dataset provides an overview of current data collected by the Traffic Information Centre of SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on faulty traffic equipment, including traffic lights, road lighting, and variable message signs on state roads. It includes information on equipment that is switched off, operating intermittently, or not functioning due to technical reasons.

title: Electric vehicle charging infrastructure
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains information from EV charging point operators on publicly available infrastructure for vehicle charging. Information provider - the operator (owner or legal holder) of the publicly accessible EV charging facilities that make the service available to users. The dataset contains static data and reflects the locations of electric vehicle charging points and the conditions for their use.

title: Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure Eco-Movement
field_dataset_description: This dataset provides detailed information about electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure from Eco-Movement for several operators. It includes the name, geographical coordinates, address, operating hours, and contact details of each charging site, along with specifications of charging points such as connector types, charging modes, and maximum socket power.

title: Unmanaged blockage of a road
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains up-to-date data on unforeseen situations and events on national roads resulting in full or partial roadblocks. As partial or total blockage of a road which is not adequately secured and signposted may necessitate emergency maneuvers, the events included in the dataset are dangerous to the safety of traffic.

title: Black points
field_dataset_description: The data set includes current data compiled by the Traffic Organization Supervision Division of SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on dangerous sections and intersections on state roads. The data of the dataset "Black Spots" are updated once every three years.

title: Variable message signs locations (E67)
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains information on variable message signs locations on the via Baltica motorway (E67), section from Ainazi to the Lithuanian border. Variable message signs have been developed in accordance with European standard EN 12966.

title: Exceptional weather conditions (Traffic information centre data)
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes current data received from the Traffic Information Center of SLLC “Latvian State Roads” about weather conditions or unforeseen elements that may affect driving conditions, such as thunderstorms, crosswinds, strong wind gusts, heavy rain, etc. As exceptional weather conditions significantly impair driving safety, the events included in the dataset are considered dangerous to traffic.

title: Weather conditions affecting road surface and visibility (Road maintenance reports)
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes current data received from road maintenance authorities on weather conditions that may affect road surface and visibility, thereby worsening driving conditions, such as snowstorms, rain showers, etc.

title: Traffic counter locations
field_dataset_description: The dataset contains current data on the locations of traffic counting devices owned by SLLC “Latvian State Roads” on state roads.

title: Poor road conditions (Road maintenance reports)
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes current data received from road maintenance authorities on conditions or events that affect the condition of the road surface and worsen driving conditions, such as ice, snow, mud, sand on the road, etc.

title: TEN-T network
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes geospatial information on the road infrastructure of the European transport network (TEN-T) in Latvia. It contains road sections of the TEN-T core and comprehensive networks in line with EU transport policy requirements, ensuring a unified and standardized representation.

title: Primary roads
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes geospatial information on sections of Latvia’s main state roads that have been assigned primary road status, in accordance with Annex 5 of Cabinet of Ministers Regulation No. 188 of 25 March 2025.

title: Road user charge (vignettes) sections
field_dataset_description: The dataset includes geospatial information on the sections of the main and regional national roads in Latvia, on which certain vehicle categories (trucks over 3.0 t, etc.) are subject to the obligation to pay a road toll. The application is regulated by the Road Toll Law and Cabinet Regulations No. 272.

title: Safe and secure parking places for trucks and commercial vehicles
field_dataset_description: Safe and secure parking places for trucks and commercial vehicles according to (EU) Regulation No 885/2013 of 15 May 2013 supplementing ITS Directive 2010/40/EU with regard to the provision of information services for safe and secure parking places for trucks and commercial vehicles

title: Location of vignettes purchase
field_dataset_description: The data set includes current data on places where it is possible to pay for the toll in the territory of Latvia. The road toll is a fee for using the main and regional roads of Latvia. The road toll is regulated by the Road Toll Law and 26.05.2014. Cabinet of Ministers Regulation No. 272 "Procedures for the Payment, Collection and Administration of the Road Toll", detailed information on the website: https://www.lvvignette.eu/ .
